From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@helixonhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@helixonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SOC2 packet review

Hi Kim — thanks for the nudge and for the packet. We’ve been going through the materials this week. A couple of blockers from our side so far: 

1) Encryption / key management: our security team is asking for an architecture diagram that shows how encryption-at-rest is handled and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). They asked for any integration docs you have for KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or HSM options).

2) Dedicated deployment timing: for certain PHI-related workloads we'd need a timeline for private/dedicated deployment and whether there are SLA commitments for latency and uptime.

3) Audit artifact handoff: they want to confirm how evidence is shared during procurement (drive links vs. an uploader) and retention rules.

Can Marissa or someone in security share a short note or diagram on the KMS story? Also, would you be able to join a 30-min call on Mon 6/28 at 11:00 AM PT? If that slot doesn’t work I can propose alternatives.

Attaching: helixon_missing_items_list.pdf (internal)

Thanks — Laura
--
Laura Chen
Head of Security & Compliance, Helixon Health
laura.chen@helixonhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@helixonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SOC2 packet review

Laura — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear list. 

Short answers and next steps:
- KMS/HSM: we support both provider-managed KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and customer-managed keys. I’m attaching a short note with the integration options and encryption-at-rest diagram (kms-integration-note.pdf). Marissa will be on the call to dive into technical details.
- Dedicated deployment & SLA: we can share a standard delivery timeline and SLA summary; Ben (cc’d) handles dedicated capacity engagements and will bring a timeline and expected lead times to the call.
- Audit artifacts: we typically provision a secure share for evidence and can support short-lived links or an SFTP uploader depending on your requirements — Marissa can confirm retention settings.

I can join Mon 6/28 11:00 AM PT — booking a 30-min slot now. If anything changes I’ll send an update with an agenda (KMS diagram, deployment timeline, evidence handoff options).

Drive (again): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Helixon-SOC2-packet
Attachment (to be sent): kms-integration-note.pdf

See you Monday — Kim

--

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
